div.span: Frames are length-prefixed postcard on an owner-only named pipe or Unix socket, never TCP. The sandbox is an AppContainer or low integrity with a job object on Windows, landlock and seccomp on Linux, a sandbox profile on macOS.

text.tspan: Frames are length-prefixed postcard on an owner-only named
pipe or Unix socket, never TCP. The sandbox is an AppContainer
or low integrity with a job object on Windows, landlock and
seccomp on Linux, a sandbox profile on macOS.
